skills.name: River Water (清流)
skills.description:
SP Kingyo Hime channels a stream of water to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK and dispels 1 of the target's buffs.
When an ally receives damage from an enemy and the damage exceeds more than 30% of their max HP, the attacker is inflicted with 3 stacks of Grudged for 2 turns. ;Grudged (因縁) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Max 3 stacks. In Fishtail Embrace, Surge targets the bearer and deals damage equal to 100% of SP Kingyo Hime's ATK, costing 1 stack of Grudge.

skills.name: Ride Wave (凌波)
skills.description:
At the end of an enemy's turn, SP Kingyo Hime gains 1 layer of Focused and gains Spiritfish Shield if she does not already have one. The shield is equal to 80% of her ATK. 
;Upper Hand
:SP Kingyo Hime automatically gains 4 layers of Focused.
;Focused (精神統一)
:
:'''General, Mark''': Max 8 stacks. When SP Kingyo Hime reaches 8 stacks, all stacks are consumed, all control effects on her are removed and all enemies are inflicted with River's Binding, lasts for 2 turns. Then activates Fishtail Embrace, lasts for 1 turn. If she already has Fishtail Embrace, her move bar is increased by 25% instead.
;Spiritfish Shield
:'''Buff''', '''Mark''': Absorbs a certain amount of damage and cannot be dispelled.
;River's Binding (川流の縛)
:
:'''Debuff, Mark''': When an inflicted enemy receives a single target move bar increasing effect, SP Kingyo Hime focuses spiritual fish energy to reverse the flow, decreasing their SPD by 40% at the end of their turn.

skills.name: Goldfish's Embrace (霊魚の心)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
SP Kingyo Hiime applies 3 stacks of Grudge onto an enemy and activates Fishtail Embrace, lasts for 1 turn. Upon activation, all allies' move bars are raised by 10% and gain one stack of Surge. During it's duration, when an enemy gains a move bar boost, gain 1 stack of Surge. After an ally's turn ends, if she is still able to act, SP Kingyo Hime heals the target for 50% of ATK and triggers Surge. ;Surge : :Max 3 stacks. Each stacks deals indirect damage equal to 50% of ATK to 1 random enemy, prioritizing different targets. Each trigger increases the damage multiplier by 3%, max 80%. ;Grudged (因縁) : :'''Debuff, Status''': ATK is decreased by 20%. Cannot be stacked.

upgrades.text: Damage dealt to enemies with Karma increases to 300%.
'''Fishtail Embrace''': Decreases non-crit damage dealt to allies by 30%.
Restore effects on allies with less than 50% HP increases to 200%.

bio.condition: Team SP Kingyo Hime with another player's Kingyo Hime and clear any zone 10 times.
Increase SP Kingyo Hime's skills 8 times.
With SP Kingyo Hime win 30 matches in Duel, Practice or Spar.
